stories.title: Moderna and Merck report first positive Phase 3 trial for mRNA cancer vaccine
stories.summary: Moderna and Merck said their mRNA neoantigen therapy succeeded in a Phase 3 trial for melanoma. It marks the first positive late-stage result for this type of personalized mRNA cancer vaccine. The companies have not yet detailed regulatory next steps.
stories.whyItMatters: A successful Phase 3 result validates mRNA technology beyond vaccines, opening a path toward personalized cancer treatment at scale.
whatToWatch: Full trial data release and peer review
Regulatory filing timelines from Moderna and Merck
questions: How large was the survival or recurrence benefit?

stories.title: Reviews of Google's Pixel 11 line question whether its edge is fading

Engadget frames the phone as offering more for a slightly higher price. The reviews reflect Google's ongoing push to compete with Apple and Samsung flagships.

stories.title: Amazon makes Alexa+ free for Fire TV owners, dropping the Prime requirement
stories.summary: Amazon is now offering its AI-powered Alexa+ assistant free to anyone with a Fire TV device, removing the previous Prime subscription requirement. The change widens access to Amazon's newer AI assistant beyond paying subscribers. Both Engadget and TechCrunch confirmed the shift.
stories.whyItMatters: Amazon is using free access to push Alexa+ adoption at scale, a key front in the broader AI-assistant race with Google and OpenAI.
whatToWatch: Whether the free tier expands to other Amazon devices

questions: What features, if any, remain Prime-exclusive?
